audio_description:
Selphie Tilmitt stands on rocky boulders against a pink dusk sky.
Selphie balances across the rocks, arms outstretched.
Close-up of Selphie smiling.

context.scene_title: Selphie Tilmitt character introduction — part of the early Disc 1 'Balamb Garden' montage introducing the cast.
locations: An outdoor rocky hilltop at dusk (pink/purple cloudy sky), near greenery

characters.name: Selphie Tilmitt
characters.recognition: Short, perky girl with short auburn/brown hair that flips up at the ends; wears a dark Garden uniform with a large yellow bow/ribbon at the collar and tall boots. Energetic and cheerful; a transfer student from Trabia Garden.

context.summary: A character-introduction clip for Selphie Tilmitt. She balances and bounds playfully across rocks on a hilltop beneath a pink dusk sky, arms outstretched, then turns to the camera with a bright, cheerful smile. It establishes her bubbly, energetic personality.
